description.p: Liveside is a Twitch chat client for viewers, moderators and broadcasters, with a window and a terminal frontend over one engine that can also run on as a background service.

ul.li: Chat in several channels, with emotes from Twitch, 7TV, BetterTTV and FrankerFaceZ, replies and whispers
Highlight, ignore and filter rules in Chatty's syntax, custom commands and hotkeys
Moderation: timeouts, bans, AutoMod's queue, unban requests and the moderation log
For broadcasters: polls, predictions, channel point rewards, the channel's title and schedule, raids and clips
Notifications for mentions, whispers and channels going live
Bots of your own, started by Liveside

description.p: Security and privacy were part of its plan from the start. Chat is text from strangers, and Liveside treats it as untrusted:

ul.li: A link opens only after its whole address has been shown, with look-alike letters made visible
Where a link leads can be found out without opening the page, and checked with VirusTotal on request
It logs in with a code, so it never sees your password, and your bots never get your login
No telemetry, and a report of everything it sends and stores

screenshot.caption: A channel's chat, with the people in it
A look-alike address shown as it really is before it opens
Where a link leads and what VirusTotal says, without opening it
What waits for a moderator: AutoMod, unban requests and rewards

description.p: A list of emotes to pick from beside the input line, telling the chat what was found out about a link, and fixes: leaving a channel at once, emoji no longer shifting lines in the terminal, and more.
The first public version: chat, moderation and the broadcaster's tools, in a window and in a terminal.
